data.name: Wonewoc Formation (Cw)
data.descrip: Quartz sandstone, medium grained, brownish yellow to white, with medium- to large-scale cross bedding commonly seen in outcrop. Reaches a maximum thickness of 165 feet (50 m) in the subsurface. Part of Elk Mound Group.

data.name: Cambrian, undivided
data.strat_name: Trempealeau Formation; Tunnel City Formation; Elk Mound Formation
data.descrip: Sandstone with some dolomite and shale, undivided; includes Trempealeau, Tunnel City, and Elk Mound Formations
